tools.name: GMAIL_FETCH_EMAILS
tools.description: Fetch email messages from the connected Gmail mailbox

tools.name: GMAIL_FETCH_MESSAGE_BY_MESSAGE_ID
tools.description: Fetch a single Gmail message by message id

tools.name: GMAIL_FETCH_MESSAGE_BY_THREAD_ID
tools.description: Fetch messages belonging to a Gmail thread

tools.name: GMAIL_SEND_EMAIL
tools.description: Send an email through the connected Gmail account

tools.name: GMAIL_CREATE_EMAIL_DRAFT
tools.description: Create a Gmail draft, optionally as a reply in a thread

tools.name: GMAIL_LIST_LABELS
tools.description: List system and user labels for the connected Gmail account

tools.name: GITHUB_LIST_RELEASES
tools.description: List releases for a GitHub repository (owner + repo). Prefer this over browsing github.com or web search when GitHub is connected.

tools.name: GITHUB_GET_RELEASE
tools.description: Get one GitHub release by tag for owner/repo, or the latest release when tag is omitted. Prefer this over a computer browser.
